usedFor: Aircall holds your phone contacts, and YCloud emails them once “New Contact” hands over a fresh record.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Aircall, then “Send an Email” in YCloud
bestTemplate.why: Every new phone contact gets a first email from YCloud, so nobody waits for a manual follow-up.

watchOut: An email that reaches a customer waits in Needs you for your approval before “Send an Email” goes out.
